newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-CROWDS BIGGER AT FRENCH LEAGUE GAMES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROWDS BIGGER AT FRENCH LEAGUE GAMES.

text.p: A mass exodus of France's top players has had no adverse effect on first division attendances, according to figures released by the French National Football League (LNF).

On the contrary, numbers are up by just over 188,000 in comparison with the same stage of the championship last year and the figure is expected to top 300,000 by the end of the season. There are 10 rounds of matches to go.
"And some stadiums in renovation because of the (1998) World Cup finals cannot take their full capacity," LNF president Noel Le Graet said.
More than half France's Euro 96 squad, including Youri Djorkaeff, Zinedine Zidane and Laurent Blanc, were signed by Italian or Spanish clubs last year.
